test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven people I, Y, O, U, R, P, and T are sitting in a straight row, facing north. P sits at the extreme right. Only six people sit to the right of R. Y sits fourth to the left of P. T is the immediate neighbour of R. I sits fourth to the right of R. U and T are the immediate neighbours of Y. O is the immediate neighbour of P. Who sits at the centre of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people I, Y, O, U, R, P, and T.

1) P sits at the extreme right.

2) Y sits fourth to the left of P.

3) Only six people sit to the right of R.

4) T is the immediate neighbour of R.

5) I sits fourth to the right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/279c65c318706cea23547526c7dfff22747e6d816b7d7d5c824bd5f1954a6db5.png] 

6) U and T are the immediate neighbours of Y.

7) O is the immediate neighbour of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ee3784d633f2c71fe030551a90aee403372c1875550dae5cab0494f853c7c2e.png] 

Here, 'U' sits at the centre of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
